changes_made.explanation: Removed duplicate datasets (FDA-approved drugs are not a dataset, PubChem BioAssay is part of PubChem), normalized model names, consolidated output descriptions
Removed duplicates and verbose descriptions, kept only unique base metric names. 'High Affinity' is not a metric but a percentage calculation based on Vina Dock score
Removed all items as the LLMs are used for BioAssay retrieval processing before generation, not as judges evaluating generated outputs after generation

guideline: Manual assessment of BioAssay relevance by reading assay descriptions and abstracts to confirm biochemical interaction and functional activity
Manual assessment of BioAssay relevance by reading assay descriptions and abstracts to confirm biochemical interaction and functional activity

- reading through the assay description and abstract for each of the 10 retrieved AIDs for each target protein and confirming whether the assay readout would correspond with a biochemical interaction of the tested compounds with a protein of the same family as the target protein. Also, where applicable we also confirmed the desired functional activity, inhibition or activation

changes_made.explanation: Simplified guideline description, added 'relevant' as a criterion since this was the main evaluation focus, removed specific activity types (inhibition/activation) which were not consistently assessed

overall_notes: This paper primarily focuses on molecule generation using LLMs with BioAssay context. The manual evaluation was specifically for validating LLM-based BioAssay relevance assessment, not for evaluating generated molecules. Most evaluations were automatic metrics applied to generated SMILES strings.
